samples.xml_description:
<module id="radix2_div">
    <description>A simplified radix-2 divider for 8-bit signed or unsigned integers.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal used for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="rst">The reset signal to initialize or reset the module.</input>
        <input id="sign">1-bit indicates if the operation is signed (1) or unsigned (0).</input>
        <input id="dividend" width_description="[7:0]">8-bit input signal representing the dividend for division.</input>
        <input id="divisor" width_description="[7:0]">8-bit input signal representing the divisor for division.</input>
        <input id="opn_valid">1-bit indicates that a valid operation request is present.</input>
        <output id="res_valid">1-bit output signal indicating the result is valid and ready.</output>
        <output id="result" width_description="[15:0]">16-bit the output containing the remainder in the upper 8 bits and the quotient in the lower 8 bits.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="IDLE">0</parameter>
        <parameter id="DIVIDE">1</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <signal id="neg_divisor" width_description="[8:0]">The negative value of the divisor.</signal>
        <signal id="sr" width_description="[16:0]">Shift register to hold the current remainder and quotient.</signal>
        <signal id="sub_result" width_description="[9:0]">Result of subtracting the divisor from the current remainder.</signal>
        <signal id="carry_out">Carry-out signal from the subtraction operation.</signal>
        <signal id="mux_out" width_description="[8:0]">Output of the multiplexer selecting between the current remainder and the result of the subtraction.</signal>
        <signal id="cnt">Counter to keep track of the number of iterations performed during division.</signal>
        <signal id="start_cnt">Signal to indicate the start of the division process.</signal>
        <signal id="abs_dividend" width_description="[7:0]">Absolute value of the dividend.</signal>
        <signal id="abs_divisor" width_description="[7:0]">Absolute value of the divisor.</signal>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // Initialize variables
        reg [7:0] abs_dividend;
        reg [7:0] abs_divisor;
        reg [16:0] sr;
        reg [8:0] neg_divisor;
        reg [3:0] cnt;
        reg start_cnt;
        
        // Sequential logic block triggered on positive edge of clk or active low reset
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst) begin
            if (!rst) begin
                // Reset all registers and signals
                sr <= 17'd0;
                neg_divisor <= 9'd0;
                cnt <= 4'd0;
                start_cnt <= 1'b0;
                abs_dividend <= 8'd0;
                abs_divisor <= 8'd0;
            end else begin
                // Check if there is a valid operation request and result is not yet valid
                if (opn_valid && !res_valid) begin
                    // Save the absolute values of dividend and divisor
                    abs_dividend <= (sign == 1'b1) ? ((dividend[7]) ? (~dividend + 1'b1) : dividend) : dividend;
                    abs_divisor <= (sign == 1'b1) ? ((divisor[7]) ? (~divisor + 1'b1) : divisor) : divisor;
                    
                    // Set the shift register to the absolute value of the dividend shifted left by one bit
                    sr <= {8'd0, abs_dividend} << 1;
                    
                    // Calculate the negative value of the divisor
                    neg_divisor <= ~(abs_divisor) + 1'b1;
                    
                    // Initialize the counter and start_cnt signals
                    cnt <= 4'd1;
                    start_cnt <= 1'b1;
                end else if (start_cnt) begin
                    // Check if the most significant bit of the counter is set
                    if (cnt[3]) begin
                        // Clear the counter and start_cnt signals
                        cnt <= 4'd0;
                        start_cnt <= 1'b0;
                        
                        // Update the shift register with the final remainder and quotient
                        sr <= mux_out;
                    end else begin
                        // Increment the counter
                        cnt <= cnt + 1'b1;
                        
                        // Perform subtraction operation
                        sub_result = {1'b0, sr[16:9]} + neg_divisor;
                        carry_out = ~sub_result[9];
                        mux_out = (carry_out) ? sub_result[8:0] : {sr[16:9], 1'b1};
                        sr <= {mux_out, sr[8:0]};
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        
        // Assign the result to the output port
        assign result = (sign == 1'b1) ? {{8{sr[16]}}, sr[15:8]} ^ {8'hff, 8'h80} :
                        (sign == 1'b0) ? {8'd0, sr[15:8]} ^ {8'hff, 8'h80} :
                        {8'd0, sr[15:8]};
        
        // Assign the validity signal to the output port
        assign res_valid = (cnt == 4'd0);
    </implementation>
</module>
